title: Country Road Marketplace - Christmas Show
seo_title: Country Road Marketplace Christmas Show in Bolivar, MO
description: This holiday shopping day brings together 50+ local crafters, artists, and small businesses selling handmade gifts, festive decor, candles, jewelry, treats, and more, with Christmas music throughout. Admission is free, and the show was formerly known as Boot Country Craft Show. It runs Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM at the Elks Lodge, 1990 W Broadway St in Bolivar, MO.
address: Elks Lodge, 1990 W Broadway St, Bolivar, MO 65613, United States, Bolivar, MO
